basis: The task's rows are the Government of Alberta's own per-wildfire operational record: 'Historical wildfire data 2006-2025' (Forest Protection Area, 27,828 wildfires), published by Forestry and Parks / Alberta Wildfire on open.alberta.ca and federated on the federal open.canada.ca portal (CKAN package a221e7a0-4f46-4be7-9c5a-e29de9a3447e). The dataset page declares 'Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta' and the licence text (read 2026-11-06 from https://open.alberta.ca/licence, version 2.2) grants: 'The Information Provider grants you a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use the Information, including for commercial purposes, subject to the terms below.' and 'You are free to: Copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt, distribute or otherwise use the Information in any medium, mode or format for any lawful purpose.' The binding conditions are attribution ('You must, where you do any of the above: Acknowledge the source of the Information by including any attribution statement specified by the Information Provider(s) and, where possible, provide a link to this licence.'; default attribution: 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Alberta.') and non-endorsement ('This licence does not grant you any right to use the Information in a way that suggests any official status or that the Information Provider endorses you or your use of the Information.'). There is no share-alike clause. The licence's 'Personal Information' exemption was verified not engaged by the shipped columns (measured 2026-11-06: assessment_resource carries 5 position categories, dispatched_resource and initial_action_by carry resource-type codes - no person names in any shipped column; and those columns are excluded from the shipped set regardless). Class A. Standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0, and the source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed.

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the all-cause assessment-instant population frame (every assessed Forest Protection Area wildfire 2006-2025, winter rows kept and counted, eligibility assessment-based with no outcome-conditioned rule), the derived binary escape label (final area burned >= 100 ha on the current compilation's recorded value), the at-instant feature derivations (elapsed hours from reported/discovered/estimated-start to the assessment instant, calendar and cyclical day-of-year fields, forest-area prefix, coordinate passthrough), the column policy that excludes every post-instant and label-source family, the winter-carryover split rule (assessment instant's calendar year, America/Edmonton local operational time) and the temporal partition (train 2006-2015 / eval 2016-2020 / holdout 2021-2025) - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the Government of Alberta's wildfire records keep their own designation and remain subject to the Open Government Licence - Alberta v2.2, whose attribution requirement carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.

source.status: One preserved upstream instrument, not relicensed. The Government of Alberta's Historical wildfire data 2006-2025 (per-fire incident records, Forest Protection Area) is licensed under the Open Government Licence - Alberta v2.2, with its attribution requirement, non-endorsement clause, no-warranty terms and (where applicable) personal-information exemption. The redistributed fields are the publisher's own assessment-instant record (assessment size, rate of spread, fire behaviour type, position on slope, in-situ weather over the fire, FBP fuel type, detection channel), pre-instant timing fields and location, plus our derived label, elapsed-time features and partition. The derived dataset is labelled as such throughout and is neither the Government of Alberta's official product nor endorsed by it.

source.derived_labelling: Labelled as a derived research dataset throughout; it is neither the Government of Alberta's official product nor endorsed by Alberta Wildfire, and the publisher has not reviewed it. The publisher's own designations and field definitions are preserved verbatim in the shipped transcript of the data dictionary; changes from the source are indicated (the all-cause assessment-instant population frame, the derived binary escape label at 100 ha final area burned, elapsed-hour and calendar feature derivations, the excluded post-instant families with measured ordering evidence, and the temporal partition).

conditions: The OGL-Alberta attribution sentence carries in every copy of the data and its documentation: 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Alberta.' with a link to https://open.alberta.ca/licence.
OGL-Alberta's non-endorsement condition carries through: the derived dataset is labelled as such and is not presented as the Government of Alberta's or Alberta Wildfire's official product.

The comparison ladder travels with every quoted figure: the runner-contract model AUC beside persistence (assessment_hectares), the calendar/identity prior, the majority-class accuracy and the construction-time full-feature logistic reference on the identical eval rows, with the day-clustered intervals; no figure may be quoted without the comparison beside it, and the construction-time full-minus-persistence interval containing zero (INCONCLUSIVE) is part of the record.

Changes are indicated: the dataset ships an all-cause assessment-instant population frame, a derived binary escape label (final area burned >= 100 ha), elapsed-hour/calendar feature derivations, an enforced column policy excluding every post-instant and label-source family, and a temporal partition (train 2006-2015 / eval 2016-2020 / holdout 2021-2025).
Our contribution is dedicated CC0-1.0; the source's terms are preserved and carry through unchanged, including attribution.
Our code and documentation are MIT.
